text: Every open AP and AR balance in Stonefield's legacy system has to move into Oracle before cutover -- not just the chart of accounts and the subledgers.
Theo loads that history using File-Based Data Import -- standard spreadsheet templates for AP invoices and AR transactions, validated before they're ever uploaded.
Validated rows stage into Oracle's interface tables, then convert into live AP and AR transactions through the Import Payables Invoices and Import AutoInvoice processes.
Theo and Simone Alvarez reconcile the loaded totals against the legacy trial balance, invoice by invoice, until every number ties out exactly.
Next: rehearsing cutover and preparing Stonefield to go live on Oracle Fusion.
